normalized_facts.advisory: Water provider: CITY OF AUSTIN WATER & WASTEWATER Capacity unverified. No sewer service area covers this parcel, and none was found nearby. On-site septic (OSSF) through the county is the likely path. Note: some cities serve sewer without a certificated area, so if the parcel is inside city limits, ask the city utility first. If the named provider doesn't match what you know about the parcel — utilities buy each other regularly and TWDB's published CCN layer can lag transfers by months — treat the will-serve letter from the actual provider as the authoritative answer.

manual_upload_request.reason: CCN territory tells you which provider has authority — it does NOT confirm capacity, extension distance, or upgrade burden. Upload a will-serve letter or SER response to confirm capacity. To verify the named provider when in doubt, use the TWDB Public Utility Search: https://www14.tceq.texas.gov/iwud/utility/index.cfm
